name: IKS Swarmbreaker
_comment: R3.52, Module R3 SSD book printed page 15 (PDF 16). Corner reads YS:172 DK:6 EX:17 CR:6, and
Annex #1 agrees on explosion strength 17 and BPV 110.
The D5 hull rebuilt to kill fighters and drones, and the trade is the whole ship: it gives up
BOTH DRONE RACKS and mounts FOUR anti-drone racks in their place, where the D5 carries two of
each. Everything it fires at a seeking weapon, it fires twice as much of.
Read against the D5I entered the same day, because these two are opposites and copying either
one into the other would be wrong in both directions:
- the forward phasers here are PHASER-1s (the D5I's are phaser-2s);
- the disruptors are RANGE 30, the full table out to the 23-30 column (the D5I stops at 22);
- it has DERFACS and a UIM — the data table says '1 x UIM STANDARD', and the disruptor
table prints HIT(UIM), HIT(DERFACS) and HIT(OL/UIM) rows the D5I's simply does not have.
This is the deep-space fit; the D5I is the one with the inferior fire control.
Everything else IS the D5, counted rather than inherited: shields 30/26 x5, hull 3 forward and
6 rear, warp 12+12, impulse 4+1 emergency, APR 2, batteries 3, three transporters, three
tractors, two shuttle boxes, 40 crew units, 8 boarding parties, sensor 6-5-3-1-0, scanner
0-1-3-5-9, damage control 4-2-2-2-0 and four excess boxes.
Two notes on the sheet we do NOT model, recorded so nobody hunts for them:
- 'LIMITED AEGIS SYSTEM CONTROLS PH-3s AND ADDs' — that one IS modelled, above.
- 'THIS SHIP CAN CONTROL A NUMBER OF SEEKING WEAPONS EQUAL TO ITS SENSOR RATING', which is
the ordinary limit stated out loud rather than a special power. Compare the D5N, whose
sheet HALVES it — that one is a real modifier and is also unmodelled.
_refitComment: The data table lists one refit: K REFIT (Y175) = +2, and the sheet says which phasers it
touches — 'PHASER-2s MARKED K ARE CHANGED TO PHASER-1s ON THE K REFIT'. The two marked boxes
are the wing phasers 3 and 4, exactly as on the D5 and the D5N. The forward pair are already
No y175Upgrades block: this hull has no drone racks to convert, and its ADDs are born with
twelve rounds ('ANTI-DRONES ALWAYS HAD 12 ROUNDS'), so the universal ADD_6 to ADD_12
conversion has nothing to do either.
